original_ai_output.title_zh: 乔纳森呼吁联邦政府重启Almajiri学校以应对不安全局势
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚前总统古德勒克·乔纳森呼吁联邦政府重启Almajiri教育计划和绿色长城项目，以应对不安全局势并为尼日利亚人创造就业。他表示这些项目旨在解决导致不安全的社会经济因素，包括青年失业问题。乔纳森在阿布贾举行的一本关于民主制度下反恐警务的新书发布会上发表上述讲话。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚前总统乔纳森呼吁联邦政府重启Almajiri教育计划和绿色长城项目以应对不安全局势
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ex-President Goodluck Jonathan has urged the Federal Government to revisit and revive the Almajiri education programme and the Great Green Wall project as part of efforts to tackle insecurity and create jobs for Nigerians.

key_facts.fact: 乔纳森称这些项目旨在解决包括青年失业在内的导致不安全的社会经济因素
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Jonathan said the programmes, introduced during his administration, were designed to address some of the socio-economic factors contributing to insecurity, including unemployment among young people.

key_facts.fact: 乔纳森在阿布贾举行的一本关于民主制度下反恐警务的新书发布会上发表讲话
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: spoke at the public presentation of Beyond the Bullets: Policing Terrorism in a Democratic System, a book written by a former Inspector-General of Police, Mohammed Abubakar, in Abuja on Saturday

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
